mapper.select: SELECT id FROM device_instance WHERE resource_id = #{param1}

INSERT INTO resource_booking (tenant_id, resource_id, period, status, source_type, note) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, tstzrange(now(), now() + interval '4 hours'), 'active', 'workflow-run', '执行期岛锁') RETURNING id
SELECT workflow_id AS "workflowId", count(*) AS "n" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND node_type = 'task' GROUP BY workflow_id
SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", (params->>'bound_resource_id')::bigint AS "rid" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND params->>'bound_resource_id' IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_node SET resource_id = #{param4}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_key = #{param3}

UPDATE workflow_node SET params = jsonb_set( CASE WHEN #{param4}::text IS NULL THEN COALESCE(params, '{}'::jsonb) ELSE jsonb_set( jsonb_set(COALESCE(params, '{}'::jsonb), '{method_params}', #{param5}::jsonb, true), '{builtin}', to_jsonb(#{param6}::boolean), true) END, '{protocol_name}', to_jsonb(#{param7}::text), true), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_key = #{param3}
mapper.select: SELECT n.node_key AS "nodeKey", c.code AS "code" FROM workflow_node n JOIN capability c ON c.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.workflow_id = #{param2} AND n.node_type = 'task'

SELECT w.id AS "id", w.code AS "code", w.name AS "name", (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task') AS "nodeCount" FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.category = 'choreography' ORDER BY w.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", type AS "type", default_value AS "defaultValue", description AS "description" FROM workflow_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_variable (tenant_id, workflow_id, name, type, default_value, description) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}) ON CONFLICT (workflow_id, name) DO UPDATE SET type = EXCLUDED.type, default_value = EXCLUDED.default_value, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = now() RETURNING id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workflow_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND name = #{param3}
mapper.select: SELECT graph->>'xml' FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT (params->'method_params')::text AS "mp", resource_id AS "resourceId", params->>'protocol_name' AS "method" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_key = #{param3}

WITH nd AS ( SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", estimate_sec AS "manual", resource_id AS "resourceId", params->>'protocol_name' AS "method", COALESCE(seq, 2147483647) AS ord, id FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' ), hist AS ( SELECT cmd.method, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cmd.finished_at - cmd.sent_at))) AS p50, count(*) AS n FROM run_command cmd WHERE cmd.tenant_id = #{param1} AND cmd.method IN (SELECT "method" FROM nd WHERE "method" IS NOT NULL) AND cmd.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND cmd.sent_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cmd.method ) SELECT nd."nodeKey", nd."name", nd."manual", nd."resourceId", nd."method", hist.p50 AS "p50", hist.n AS "n", (SELECT max(dm.estimate_sec) FROM device_method dm WHERE dm.method = nd."method" AND dm.estimate_sec > 0) AS "devEst" FROM nd LEFT JOIN hist ON hist.method = nd."method" ORDER BY nd.ord, nd.id

SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.run_id AS "runId", n.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", n.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.run_no AS "runNo", res.code AS "resCode", GREATEST(0, COALESCE(n.estimate_sec, 0) - COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - n.actual_start)), 0)) AS "remain" FROM run_node n JOIN run r ON r.id = n.run_id LEFT JOIN resource_node res ON res.id = n.resource_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.resource_id = #{param2} AND n.level = 0 AND n.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running' ORDER BY "remain" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.status::text AS "status", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.actual_end AS "actualEnd", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.actual_end - r.actual_start)) AS "durationSec", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "total", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'completed') AS "done", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'manual') AS "manual", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'failed') AS "failed" FROM run r LEFT JOIN run_node n ON n.run_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id = #{param2} GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT id AS "id", node_count AS "nodeCount", edge_count AS "edgeCount", length(xml) AS "bytes", saved_at AS "savedAt" FROM workflow_graph_history WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} ORDER BY saved_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT xml FROM workflow_graph_history WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND id = #{param3}

SELECT GREATEST(0, COALESCE(n.estimate_sec, 0) - COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - n.actual_start)), 0)) AS "remain" FROM run_node n JOIN run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.resource_id = #{param2} AND n.level = 0 AND n.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running' ORDER BY "remain" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT code FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
